items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: No, you might know this guy, Caesar... Caesar used to arrange for them too sometimes... I don't think we bought him a side chord or a ranger.

ctx.x: The Sonny South band, he played mostly Stocker and Jackson. Father Spearsman, yeah, Stocker and Jackson. He didn't have any range in the band.
No, you might know this guy, Caesar. At that time, he was very good with the range. Saxon. Saxon, yeah. And Sonny Johnson, yeah, Sonny Johnson. He was with the band, too. I never had met Sonny.
